new_findings_this_cycle.title: Regression: honest SIMULATED status replaced with false EXECUTED in ExecutionEngine default/LLM branch
new_findings_this_cycle.evidence: ExecutionEngine.kt:153-192 — fix_engine.patch changed ExecutionOutcome.Simulated/status=SIMULATED to ExecutionOutcome.Executed/status=EXECUTED for every actionType other than CALENDAR_SYNC and RULE_EVALUATION; 'evidence' is only a hash of the LLM's own free-text reply
new_findings_this_cycle.note: This branch is the else/default case, so it is hit by any actionType not explicitly CALENDAR_SYNC or RULE_EVALUATION - likely the most common path.

new_findings_this_cycle.title: ExecutionEngineTest.kt assertions stale relative to current ExecutionEngine contract
new_findings_this_cycle.evidence: ExecutionEngineTest.kt still accepts status=="SIMULATED" (code can no longer return it) and does not account for status=="EXECUTED" (code can now return it via the regressed branch); passes today only because the Robolectric test environment happens to hit the BLOCKED branch first

new_findings_this_cycle.title: AgentCommandInjectionScreen is fully navigable UI theater
new_findings_this_cycle.evidence: ui/AgentCommandInjectionScreen.kt, wired at MainActivity.kt:511 route 'command_injection'; viewModel parameter passed but never referenced in the function body (0 usages); 'agent response' is a hardcoded canned string claiming injection into an event queue that never happens

new_findings_this_cycle.title: AgentResourceMonitorWorker uses Math.random() as fake threshold detection, self-documented as simulation
new_findings_this_cycle.evidence: workers/AgentResourceMonitorWorker.kt — 'val exceededThreshold = Math.random() > 0.8 // Simulate 20% chance of exceeding threshold'; hardcoded agent name 'Syntezator Danych' in the log message regardless of actual colony state; code comment admits 'In a real app, we would trigger a local Notification here'

new_findings_this_cycle.title: AgentResourceMonitorWorker enqueued without enqueueUniquePeriodicWork
new_findings_this_cycle.evidence: MainActivity.kt:67-68 uses plain WorkManager.enqueue() for a PeriodicWorkRequest; the other 8 periodic workers in the same file correctly use enqueueUniquePeriodicWork with ExistingPeriodicWorkPolicy.KEEP; causes duplicate periodic worker chains to accumulate across app cold starts

new_findings_this_cycle.title: Backup exclusion rules reference a SharedPreferences filename that does not match the actual vault file
new_findings_this_cycle.evidence: backup_rules.xml and data_extraction_rules.xml exclude 'secret_vault.xml'; LocalEncryptedVault.kt:16 actually creates 'encrypted_vault_prefs.xml'. Low practical risk since the AES key is Keystore-bound and non-exportable, but the exclusion rule is dead as written.

new_findings_this_cycle.title: Manifest declares FOREGROUND_SERVICE / FOREGROUND_SERVICE_DATA_SYNC permissions with no corresponding foreground service in code
new_findings_this_cycle.evidence: AndroidManifest.xml declares both permissions; zero startForeground() calls anywhere in app/src/main after the P0-8 Service-to-Worker conversion

new_findings_this_cycle.title: ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION requested at runtime but not declared in manifest (unresolved from prior cycle)
new_findings_this_cycle.evidence: MainActivity.kt:79 adds android.Manifest.permission.ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION to the runtime request list; AndroidManifest.xml does not declare <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION"/>
